description: Fork of exp664 (1.4630 @ 86.5M, current tiny bs=16 SOTA). Single change: add ONE read_out LUT module right before unembedder (after all 6 LUTBlocks complete). read_out is a TinyMHLut with same structure as out_proj (NAP=6, n_heads=6, tph=256, n_out_per_head=64, input_dim=E=384). Wired with residual: x_lut = x_lut + read_out(x_lut). Adds 6.29M params, total ~92.8M (NOT param-matched, +7%). Tests whether one final non-linear LUT 'read-out' transformation on the residual stream before unembedder helps (vs exp665 which split LUTs across every block and lost ~20 mb). Reference: exp664 = 1.4630 (86.5M, must beat), exp660 = 1.4745 (100M), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
